dict.string: TradeAutopsy Station needs Input Monitoring to register global hotkeys (⌥Space) for intervention from any app.
TradeAutopsy Station needs Screen Recording so you can grab a chart region onto Live capture. Images stay on this Mac until you link them to a trade.
TradeAutopsy uses your microphone to let you record voice journal entries about your trades, which are transcribed on-device into text.
TradeAutopsy transcribes your voice journal entries into text using on-device speech recognition. Audio is not sent to Apple or any external server.
